newsitem.title: UK: UK's GUS falls 18p on downbeat statement.
newsitem.headline: UK's GUS falls 18p on downbeat statement.

text.p: British stores to home shopping group Great Universal Stores Plc shares fell 18p after the company said first half profits had slipped and difficulties were being felt in overseas units due to sterling's strength.
GUS shares were around 655-1/2p at 0840 GMT, down 20-1/2p from yesterday' close.
Pretax profits fell to 235.6 million stg from 237.5 million stg in the six months to September 30 1996 compared with analysts expectations of between 232-235 million stg.
Sales rose to 1.21 billion stg from 1.20 billion stg a year earlier. The group announced a dividend of 5.5p, up from 5.0p.
